rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Parliament's page for the Students' Parliament of 25 July 2018 says the students would re-enact the occasion 'which occurred in the National Assembly on 9 May 1994, when Ms Sisulu nominated Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela as democratic South Africa's first President'.
